page.layout: One page of text, title page centred: all lines in one block, with a woodcut ornament between the title and the printer's imprint. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Religioni Catholicæ, Sedi Apostolicæ, Ecclesiis, aliisque Locis Piis, ac Personis, & Juribus Ecclesiasticis quomodolibet præjudicialium.
Anno reparatæ salutis à partu Virginis 1651.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a block of floral printer's ornaments) between the title and the imprint; not transcribed. A decorative rule separates the Iuxta line from the printer's line. The title line "INNOCENTII" is set in spaced capitals. The "Sanctissimi" line is in italic with the N.D. in a large italic capital.
